response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) as avg_remaincount, COUNT(*) as exec_count FROM orderexecutions WHERE expirespot >= '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND expirespot <= '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY ordersmark) SELECT AVG(avg_remaincount) as average_of_per_order_averages, SUM(exec_count) as total_execution_count FROM per_order;
